sonnet.problem: The joke repeats the shape and idea of card 3. Both set a count of times Papa Dorin fusses over a small task ('reorganizing the sprinkle shelf FOUR times', 'I check the oven THREE times') against what the Bible people do. Card 1 also uses a number-based comparison ('four people take forty minutes').
sonnet.rule: Each joke idea, comparison and punchline shape is used once per lesson. A callback is the one exception, and it adds something new.
